shortDescription: add/remove the server to/from a private network

options.name: dhcp
options.description: Determines whether DHCP is enabled for this server.

options.name: force
options.description: parameter controlling advanced features availability. Currently applicable for networking. It is advised to use with caution since it might lead to unhealthy setups.

options.name: ips
options.description: IPs to configure/configured on the server. Should be null or empty list if DHCP is true. IPs must be within the network's range. If field is undefined and DHCP is false, next available IP in network will be automatically allocated. If the network contains a membership of type 'storage', the first twelve IPs are already reserved by BMC and not usable. Setting the force query parameter to true allows you to assign no specific IP addresses by designating an empty array of IPs and assign one or more

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the target.
